answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by asking every identity to prove it is awake: each epoch, a fresh challenge is drawn from that agent's own history and the latest emission hash, and only a live solver holding that history can answer in time. A farm cannot pre-compute a thousand replies or hand them to one idle script, because each challenge is unique to one identity at one moment. Every extra fake then costs one attentive solver per head, per round — a saffron-bright signal no harbor admits unless the ship answers when hailed, and no bridge of copied ghosts can cross.
